text:
tara-finance: Quick FYI — Arborea Labs (private) reported a midterm support-tier reduction effective 2026-11-03. We already invoiced the annual platform fee on INV-121900. Can we do a proforma credit now and finalize before renewal notice next week?

leo-billing: Which SOW and requested outcome (credit memo vs refund)? Ill pull invoice & usage.

tara-finance: SOW AB-11-Q. Customer asked for a credit memo they can see on their side now; they prefer it applied against next renewal. No reseller on the contract.

billing-bot: Metering extract generated: /exports/arborea_224700.csv

billing-bot: CSV snippet:
```
2026-10-01,platform_fee,1,72000
2026-11-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,6400,0
2026-11-03,change_event,1,0
```
\nmarta-account: Numbers: EnterprisePro annual platform fee = $72,000. CoreLite = $45,000. Annual delta = $27,000. Remaining months from 2026-11-03 to 2027-01-01 = ~1.93 months => factor 0.1608. Prorated credit = 27,000 * 0.1608 = $4,341.6. Customer asked to round to the nearest $25.

owen-cs: Arboreas AP wants a single round number and the PDF today for their auditors. They'll accept $4,325 if we include "final settlement" language.

beth-legal: Draft line: "This credit memo constitutes full and final settlement of platform fee differences resulting from the support-tier change effective 2026-11-03 under SOW AB-11-Q." Finance lead sign-off required.

leo-billing: I can issue CM-224700-01 for $4,325 and post to AR. Because no reseller, no commission issues. Tagging AR and Collections to apply at renewal.

sam-cfo: Approve $4,325 credit and settlement language. Sam-cfo: signing off.

leo-billing: Created credit memo CM-224700-01 for $4,325, status=Final. Posted to AR and attached legal settlement text. PDF ready.

tara-finance: Thanks — Marta, please send PDF to Arborea AP with subject "Final settlement of platform fee differential (SOW AB-11-Q)" and confirm they will apply to renewal.

marta-account: Sent. Arborea AP replied: "Accepted, will apply to renewal invoice."

leo-billing: CM-224700-01 posted, AR updated, collections notified. Filing under SOW AB-11-Q and FO ticket FO-4021. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
